name: file_permissions
title: Manage File Permissions
description: Modify file or directory ownership and permission metadata through the cryptographic privileged helper daemon. Supports chmod (mode changes) and chown (ownership changes) actions. Path-based denylists and SUID/SGID bit restrictions are enforced. Requires Admin authorization; user confirmation is recommended before execution. Async: poll job_get with the returned job_id. ADMIN_AUTH_REQUIRED: authorize first. REQUIRED: 1. chmod XOR chown 2. apply. IF INVALID_PERMISSION_MODE: drop SUID/SGID bits. DO NOT shell chmod; helper verifies.

recursive.description: Apply mode changes recursively to directory contents.

recursive.description: Apply ownership changes recursively to directory contents.
